summary: Taysha Gene Therapies filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under an automatic shelf registration statement for an underwritten public offering of 32,500,001 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 833,333 shares at a public offering price of $6.00 per share, representing a ~13.5% discount to the prior day's close of $6.94. Joint book-running managers include Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, Piper Sandler, and Cantor. The offering is a standard equity raise, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or structural event beyond capital formation. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes.
